item.title: Soma 1.0 (821)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (821)

  • New Screenshots space (Mac only): point Soma at your screenshots folder. Screenshots are processed through OCR and become searchable.
  • Fine tune Cortex for screenshot processing: “how many screenshots did I take in October?”, “find the screenshot with the BGP table”.
  • Share to Soma from your iPhone or iPad: New Note, New Task or Add to Note. New Task is in the Mac’s Share menu too.
  • People Hierarchy: Improved layout functionality.
  • Taller search boxes everywhere and a wider sidebar.
  • Plus quite a few other minor fixes.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
